description.value: Volcano Sushi & Grill is a Japanese restaurant on East Hastings Street offering sushi, robata grill, teriyaki, and noodle dishes in a newly renovated two-storey space. The restaurant is notable for its robotic food delivery system and availability of private dining rooms for groups. Signature items include the Vancouver Roll made with real crab meat and wild salmon, and the all-day customizable combo sets.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the business name, phone number, and address matching the OSM record. Takeout/pickup is explicitly offered ('for pick up and phone order only'). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling amenities on the website. The OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website and address clearly place this on East Hastings Street in Vancouver proper — worth flagging.
concerns: OSM community field is set to 'North Vancouver' but the business address (2053 East Hastings Street) is in the City of Vancouver, not North Vancouver. The website confirms 'Vancouver, BC'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating sushi restaurant with an active website, confirmed address, and takeout service — a useful stop for touring cyclists on East Hastings Street.

Takeout.detail: Website explicitly offers pickup orders: 'pick up and phone order only on Tuesday' and 'Online Order' with pickup option

wow_evidence: robotic food delivery system... Vancouver Roll made with real crab meat and wild salmon
